LanguageData.Gun_MachinePistol.label: UZI
LanguageData.Gun_MachinePistol.description: A compact and fully automatic submachine gun, the UZI is known for its high rate of fire and ease of handling. Perfect for close-quarters combat where rapid bursts of bullets can overwhelm opponents. However, its short barrel limits accuracy and stopping power at long ranges.
